critical_code_review_comments: quick-add.tsx:107-137 reconcileDealer uses React Native Alert.alert with 3 buttons — on web this maps to window.confirm-style dialog which may block Playwright without a 'dialog' handler. Fine on native. Fine functionally.

quick-add.tsx:209 doSave useCallback has an ESLint-disable for exhaustive-deps — profileFields is captured via closure; ok as long as top()/tagVals recompute on the current render before save is triggered.

BottomBar.tsx testID for chooser options is derived as `tab-${name}-${label.toLowerCase()}` yielding 'tab-catalog-community catalog' with a SPACE (not URL-safe). Works with data-testid attribute selectors, but flag: some CI tools split on whitespace — consider slug (label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')). Non-blocking.

Dealer Catalogs option (BottomBar.tsx:88) has route:'/community' with comingSoon:true — but onPress ignores comingSoon and still navigates to /community. Consider blocking navigation when comingSoon (or the visual chip won't reflect the 'coming soon' semantics if user actually taps it).
quick-add.tsx: no test coverage of qa-save flow in this iteration because UI login didn't complete; iter93 verified qa-save creates a tool + navigates to /tool/{id}?startEdit=1 successfully.
